difference_convention: left minus right NLL; negative favors left. Interaction=(RT+NextLat-RT)-(NextLat-ordinary).

qualification: One seed, approximately 20–22M valid-input-token recovery pilot; equal data exposure, not equal compute. Development subsets only; tests untouched. All valid same-document targets, reset context per window, unknown OLMo pretraining overlap. Cluster intervals describe sampled evaluation documents, not seed variability or research efficacy.
